{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsDJaD3cwCsmndow1Aki","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XnK2fdDEYzxxXU5nQhoJe1","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport csv, re, unicodedata\n\nlines = open('/app/dataset/genealogy_trees.txt', encoding='utf-8').read().split('\\n')\ngrid = lines[5:110]  # rows of tree art (0-indexed lines 5..109)\n\npeople = {}\nwith open('/app/dataset/people_accounts.csv', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n    for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n        full = f\"{row['first_name']} {row['last_name']}\"\n        people[full] = int(row['account_balance'])\nprint(\"people:\", len(people), \"unique:\", len(set(people)))\n\n# extract letter-fragments per row: runs of letters (incl. accented) and spaces between words\nfrag_re = re.compile(r\"[^\\W\\d_]+(?: [^\\W\\d_]+)*\", re.UNICODE)\nfrags = []\nfor r, line in enumerate(grid):\n    for m in frag_re.finditer(line):\n        frags.append((r, m.start(), m.end(), m.group()))\nprint(\"fragments:\", len(frags))\nfrom collections import Counter\nc = Counter(f[3] for f in frags)\nprint(c.most_common(20))\nEOF","description":"Extract text fragments from tree grid"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2109,"cache_read_input_tokens":24030,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2109,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"377ed040-d15f-45f4-8d67-92a1c3e8034f","uuid":"d71174e4-4cad-45ab-aac5-e740e31e70ca","request_id":"req_011CcsDJYZpahe2ieRr3PFKn"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsDLdQady55R2WFkAy4J","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KNqY1Miyg4NPC3ZesfFJRv","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport csv, re\n\nlines = open('/app/dataset/genealogy_trees.txt', encoding='utf-8').read().split('\\n')\ngrid = lines[5:110]\n\npeople = {}\nwith open('/app/dataset/people_accounts.csv', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n    for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n        people[f\"{row['first_name']} {row['last_name']}\"] = int(row['account_balance'])\n\nfrag_re = re.compile(r\"[^\\W\\d_]+(?: [^\\W\\d_]+)*\", re.UNICODE)\nfrags = []\nfor r, line in enumerate(grid):\n    for m in frag_re.finditer(line):\n        frags.append([r, m.start(), m.end(), m.group()])\n\nused = [False]*len(frags)\nboxes = []  # (name, row, colstart, colend)\n\ndef overlap(a, b):\n    return min(a[2], b[2]) - max(a[1], b[1]) > 0\n\n# 1) two-row combos (vertical wrap): fragA on row r, fragB on row r+1, overlapping cols\nby_row = {}\nfor i, f in enumerate(frags):\n    by_row.setdefault(f[0], []).append(i)\n\nmatched = {}\nfor i, f in enumerate(frags):\n    if used[i]: continue\n    # try single-fragment full-name match\n    if f[3] in people:\n        # but could also be part of a wrap; prefer wrap if combo matches?
